how: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft. Turn from the waist and lower back (Ming Men), and let the arms swing loosely like empty sleeves. Let the hands tap the body as they swing: the front of the body, and the lower back over the kidneys. Breathe easy and keep it relaxed.
lineage: Shaolin · classic qigong (Shuai Shou Gong 甩手功)
name: Arm Swinging Qigong
notes: Also known as Zhuan Yao Shuai Shou (turning the waist, swinging the arms).
